info.title: Doctor Management & Appointment Booking API
info.description:
REST API for the Doctor Management and Simple Appointment Booking System.

Roles: Management (admin), Doctor, Regular user (patient).

Authentication uses Laravel Sanctum bearer tokens. Obtain a token from POST /api/v1/login, then send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
